title: SYNBIO TECH INC 公布益生菌 LP28 预防感冒及增强 NK 细胞活性临床试验结果
originalTitle: The Influence of Long-Term Supplementation with Lactiplantibacillus plantarum LP28 on NK Cell Activity and Upper Respiratory Symptoms in Middle-Aged and Older Adults: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Trial
summary: SYNBIO TECH INC 公布一项针对50-75岁中老年人群的12周随机双盲试验，显示每日服用5×10^9 CFU的Lactiplantibacillus plantarum LP28益生菌胶囊可显著降低感冒发生率（34.78% vs 52.00%）并提升NK细胞活性，同时降低血清CRP水平。
reason: 试验数据显示益生菌干预可显著降低中老年人群感冒发生率（34.78% vs 52.00%）并提升NK细胞活性，为免疫调节提供新证据。
